mcq.e: Stargate is OpenAI's data-center project with Oracle and SoftBank. Colossus, the Memphis supercomputer, is xAI's.

mcq.q: Who is the CEO of Alibaba, the company behind the Qwen models?
mcq.e: The notes list Eddie Wu as Alibaba's CEO. Jack Ma is the founder, Pony Ma founded Tencent and Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance.

mcq.q: Which company owns the e-commerce platform Lazada?
mcq.e: Lazada is owned by Alibaba. Shopee is the platform owned by Sea Ltd.

mcq.q: Trainium is an AI chip made by which company?
mcq.e: Trainium and Inferentia are AWS chips. Google makes the TPU, Microsoft makes Maia and Nvidia makes H100/B200/Rubin.

mcq.q: In GPT-4o, what does the letter o stand for?
mcq.e: The notes explain 4o as 'omni'. The separate o-series (o1) refers to reasoning models.

mcq.q: Who founded Alibaba in 1999?
mcq.e: Alibaba was founded by Jack Ma in Hangzhou. Pony Ma founded Tencent, Ren Zhengfei founded Huawei and Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance.

mcq.q: In which city is Mistral AI based?
mcq.e: Mistral AI is a Paris company led by CEO Arthur Mensch, described as Europe's champion.

mcq.q: ASTI and PCIEERD are councils or institutes under which Philippine department?
mcq.e: The notes place PCIEERD and ASTI under DOST, the Department of Science and Technology. DICT handles ICT policy.

mcq.q: Who is the President and co-founder of OpenAI?
mcq.e: Greg Brockman is OpenAI's President and co-founder. Sarah Friar is the CFO and Bret Taylor is the Chair.

mcq.q: Which GPT-6 family model is the low-cost tier?
mcq.e: In the September 2026 GPT-6 family, Astra is top-tier, Sol is the balanced default and Luna is low-cost. GPT-6.1 Sol followed on 29 Sep.

mcq.q: Who is the President of Anthropic?
mcq.e: Daniela Amodei is Anthropic's President, while Dario Amodei is CEO. Brockman is OpenAI's President.

mcq.q: Which Claude model was released on 28 September 2026?
mcq.e: Claude Sonnet 5.5 came on 28 Sep. Claude Opus 5.5 arrived on 22 Sep and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 7 Oct.

mcq.q: Mythos Preview was made available through which Anthropic initiative?
mcq.e: The restricted Claude Mythos tier is offered as Mythos Preview via Project Glasswing. Constitutional AI and the Responsible Scaling Policy are separate Anthropic frameworks.

mcq.q: On what date did Gemini 4 'Argon' become publicly available?
mcq.e: Gemini 4 Argon was announced on 30 Sep / 1 Oct 2026 but went public on 13 Oct 2026.

mcq.q: In which year was Google Brain merged with DeepMind?
mcq.e: Google Brain merged with DeepMind in 2023. DeepMind was acquired in 2014 and Alphabet was created in 2015.

mcq.q: Which Meta model was released on 8 April 2026?
mcq.e: Muse Spark came out on 8 Apr 2026, while Muse Wonder followed on 12 Oct 2026. Llama 4 was April 2025 and its line is now paused.

mcq.q: Which AI leader left Meta in November 2025 to start his own venture?
mcq.e: The notes say Turing Award winner Yann LeCun left Meta in Nov 2025. Alexandr Wang remains Chief AI Officer.

mcq.q: On what date was SpaceX's acquisition of xAI announced?
mcq.e: SpaceX acquiring xAI was announced on 2 Feb 2026. The 21 April date is Apple's CEO announcement.

mcq.q: Which model released on 23 October 2026 is a 2.8 trillion-parameter MoE with open weights?
mcq.e: Kimi K3.1 Pro from Moonshot AI matches the 23 Oct 2026 date and 2.8 T-parameter MoE. Qwen 4 is still in training.

mcq.q: Which two companies are behind the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)?
mcq.e: ACP is from OpenAI plus Stripe. Google's counterpart is AP2, the Agent Payments Protocol.

mcq.q: Which trio created AlexNet, which won ImageNet in 2012?
mcq.e: AlexNet was by Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever and Geoffrey Hinton. Hinton, LeCun and Bengio won the 2018 Turing Award, and Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams popularized backpropagation in 1986.

mcq.q: Who won the 2023 ACM Turing Award for work on complexity and randomness?
mcq.e: Avi Wigderson won in 2023. Metcalfe won in 2022, Dongarra in 2021 and Bennett (with Brassard) in 2025.

mcq.q: Along with Jensen Huang, who co-founded Nvidia in 1993?
mcq.e: Nvidia was founded by Huang, Malachowsky and Priem. Noyce and Moore founded Intel and Hastings and Randolph founded Netflix.

mcq.q: Which company did IBM acquire in 2019 for about $34 billion?
mcq.e: The notes say IBM bought Red Hat for $34 B in 2019. Sun was bought by Oracle in 2010 and GitHub by Microsoft in 2018.

mcq.q: On what date was Python 3.15 released?
mcq.e: Python 3.15 was released on 9 Oct 2026, with 3.15.1 following on 21 Oct. Python 3.14 came out in Oct 2025.

mcq.q: Which HDMI version, announced in January 2025, supports 96 Gbps?
mcq.e: The notes list HDMI 2.1 as the mainstream standard and HDMI 2.2 (96 Gbps) as announced in Jan 2025.

mcq.q: Which Philippine law is Republic Act 11934?
mcq.e: RA 11934 is the SIM Registration Act. The Data Privacy Act is RA 10173, Cybercrime RA 10175 and Internet Transactions RA 11967.

mcq.q: Which is the Philippine internet exchange?
mcq.e: PHOPEX is the Philippine Open Internet Exchange. PHNet was the first Philippine Internet connection (1994) and dotPH handles the .ph domain.

mcq.q: Which regional language model from AI Singapore covers Filipino?
mcq.e: The notes cite SEA-LION by AI Singapore as a regional model covering Filipino. Gemma is Google's open model family.

mcq.q: Which was the first registered domain name, in 1985?
mcq.e: symbolics.com (1985) is the first domain. info.cern.ch (1991) was the first website, a different milestone.
